[Demo Mode — Grounded Statutory Rules]

### 📋 Aapki Legal Position Ka Analysis

**1. Kya Hua Hai (What Happened):**
Aapke description ke mutabiq, Landlord / Property Owner ke sath ₹30,000 ke amount ko lekar dispute hua hai.

**2. Zaroori Facts (Important Facts):**
- Aapka Role: Tenant
- Disputed Amount: ₹30,000
- Agreement Status: Written agreement exists
- Available Evidence: Bank Transfer Proof / Account Statements, WhatsApp / SMS Chat Records

**3. Applicable Indian Laws & Citations:**
- **Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (Guidelines & State Enactments) — Section 11 & Section 13**: Cap on Security Deposit and Condition for Deductions ([Official Source](https://mohua.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/Model_Tenancy_Act_English.pdf))
- **The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 106**: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2338?view_type=browse&sam_handle=123456789/1362))
- **The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 108(m) & (o)**: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2338?view_type=browse&sam_handle=123456789/1362))
- **The Specific Relief Act, 1963 — Section 6**: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/1583))

**4. Aapke Rights & Protections:**
- Indian law ke mutabiq, bina itemized proof ke security deposit ya earned salary withhold karna unlawful hai.
- Normal wear & tear (jaise routine painting) tenant ki liability nahi hoti (Transfer of Property Act Section 108).

**5. Available Remedies:**
- Formal written Demand Notice (15-day compliance window ke sath).
- State Rent Authority / Consumer Commission (e-Daakhil) / Labour Commissioner me petition file karna.

**6. Practical Options:**
- Pehle traceable channel (Email + Speed Post / WhatsApp) se clear written notice bhein.
- Bina advocate ke bhi National Consumer Helpline (1915) ya NALSA se pre-litigation help le sakte hain.

**7. Risks & Limitations:**
- Agar counterparty refuse kare, to statutory forum me proceed karna hoga jisme documentation solid honi chahiye.

**8. Recommended Next Steps:**
1. 'Document Generator' tab se Demand Draft generate karein.
2. Evidence Checklist ke document collect karke verify karein.

citations.title: Cap on Security Deposit and Condition for Deductions
citations.description: Limits security deposit for residential premises to a maximum of two months' rent. Requires refund of security deposit to the tenant at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making valid deductions agreed under the tenancy agreement.
citations.jurisdiction: Model Central Act (Adopted by States such as AP, TN, UP)

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.
